text: [S1] Hi, I'd like to return a jacket I bought last week. [S2] Sure, do you have your receipt? [S1] Yeah, right here. [S2] Perfect. Any reason for the return? [S1] It's a bit too small. [S2] No problem. Would you like an exchange or a refund? [S1] A refund please. [S2] Done, it'll be back in three to five days.

[S1] Hello, my internet's been down since this morning. [S2] Sorry to hear that. Can I get your account number? [S1] It's 847-229. [S2] Thanks. I can see an outage in your area. [S1] When will it be fixed? [S2] Should be resolved within two hours. [S1] Okay, I'll wait. Thanks. [S2] Of course, sorry for the trouble.

[S1] I think I was charged twice for my order. [S2] Let me pull that up. What's your order number? [S1] It's 10045. [S2] You're right, there's a duplicate charge. [S1] Can you fix that? [S2] Absolutely, I'll refund the extra charge now. [S1] Great, thank you. [S2] You're all set. Have a good day.

[S1] Hi, I need to cancel my subscription. [S2] I can help. Mind if I ask why? [S1] I just don't use it enough. [S2] Understood. I can pause it instead if you'd like. [S1] No, I'd rather cancel. [S2] Alright, it's cancelled. You'll have access until the end of the month. [S1] Perfect, thanks.

[S1] My package says delivered but I never got it. [S2] I'm sorry about that. Let me check the tracking. [S1] It says delivered at 3pm yesterday. [S2] It looks like it may have been left at the front door. [S1] I checked and it's not there. [S2] I'll send a replacement right away. [S1] Thank you so much. [S2] Of course, so sorry for the hassle.

[S1] Hi, I can't log into my account. [S2] I can help reset that. What's your email? [S1] It's jane at gmail dot com. [S2] I've sent a reset link. [S1] Got it. [S2] Let me know if you have any trouble. [S1] It worked, thanks. [S2] Great, glad we got that sorted.

[S1] Excuse me, this coffee is cold. [S2] Oh, I'm so sorry. Let me remake that for you. [S1] Thank you. I also ordered a muffin. [S2] Coming right up. [S1] I appreciate it. [S2] Here you go, fresh and hot. [S1] Perfect, thank you. [S2] Enjoy, sorry again for the wait.

[S1] I'd like to change my flight to Thursday. [S2] Let me check availability. [S1] I'm flexible on timing. [S2] There's a seat on the 9am. [S1] That works great. [S2] There's a fifty dollar change fee. [S1] That's fine, go ahead. [S2] Done, you'll get a confirmation by email.

[S1] Hi, I got the wrong item in my order. [S2] I'm sorry about that. What did you receive? [S1] I ordered blue but got red. [S2] We'll ship the correct one today. [S1] Do I need to send this back? [S2] No, you can keep it. [S1] Oh wow, thanks! [S2] Happy to help, sorry for the mix-up.

[S1] My card was declined but I know there's money in there. [S2] That can happen sometimes. Can I verify your details? [S1] Sure, it's the Visa ending in 4421. [S2] I see a temporary hold. It should clear by tomorrow. [S1] Is there anything I can do now? [S2] You could try a different card in the meantime. [S1] Alright, thanks for explaining. [S2] Of course, sorry for the inconvenience.

[S1] Hey, what are you up to this weekend? [S2] Not much, maybe hiking. You? [S1] I was thinking the same thing actually. [S2] No way, we should go together. [S1] That'd be fun. Where were you thinking? [S2] Maybe the trail up by the lake. [S1] Perfect, I've been wanting to try that one. [S2] Let's do Saturday morning then.

[S1] Have you seen the new place that opened downtown? [S2] The ramen spot? [S1] Yeah, it looks amazing. [S2] I walked by last night, the line was huge. [S1] Worth it though, I heard. [S2] We should check it out this week. [S1] I'm in, Tuesday works for me. [S2] Tuesday's perfect, I'll text you.

[S1] I can't believe how fast that season went. [S2] I know, feels like it just started. [S1] Did you finish it? [S2] Last night, I stayed up way too late. [S1] Same. The ending was wild. [S2] I did not see that coming at all. [S1] We need to talk about it properly. [S2] Coffee tomorrow, yes, absolutely.

[S1] You seem tired, everything okay? [S2] Just a long week honestly. [S1] Tell me about it. [S2] Work's been a lot. My boss keeps moving deadlines. [S1] That's so frustrating. [S2] It is, but it's fine. How are you? [S1] Good, just glad it's Friday. [S2] Right? Can't come soon enough.

[S1] Did you end up getting that plant? [S2] I did! It's on my windowsill now. [S1] Oh nice, which one? [S2] A little pothos. Very hard to kill apparently. [S1] Ha, that's the key criteria. [S2] You should come if you're free Saturday. [S1] I'd love that, thanks for the invite. [S2] Of course, it wouldn't be the same without you.

[S1] I finally tried that recipe you sent me. [S2] And? [S1] It was so good, honestly. [S2] Right? I've made it like four times now. [S1] The sauce especially. What's in it? [S2] It's mostly just butter and garlic, nothing fancy. [S1] I knew it. The best things always are. [S2] Ha, exactly.

[S1] I just got back from that coffee shop you recommended. [S2] Oh yeah? [S1] It was perfect. Exactly my vibe. [S2] I knew you'd like it. Did you try their oat latte? [S1] I did, it was amazing. [S2] Best in the city I think. [S1] Fully agree. I'll definitely go back. [S2] Told you.

[S1] Are you watching the game tonight? [S2] Obviously, you? [S1] Yeah, come watch at mine if you want. [S2] I was hoping you'd say that. [S1] I'll get snacks. [S2] I'll bring something to drink. [S1] Perfect, around seven? [S2] Seven works, see you then.
